entities.summary: Rocco Zikarsky is an Australian professional basketball player for the Minnesota Timberwolves of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Iowa Wolves of the NBA G League. He previously played for the Brisbane Bullets of the National Basketball League (NBL). He was drafted by the Chicago Bulls in the second round of the 2025 NBA draft.
